frames.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one master frontal keyframe for a cinematic facial portrait turn on ELORA's Persian website. New fictional adult Iranian woman aged 25, beautifully balanced subtly filler-enhanced full lips and rounded high cheeks, dark almond-shaped brown eyes, expressive dark brows, natural warm olive skin with visible pores and tiny imperfections, restrained makeup, closed relaxed lips. Iranian silk scarf folded into a wide headband, tied behind the head (تل از روسری), ivory and powder pink silk with very fine muted champagne pattern, dark brown hair swept neatly behind shoulders, headband on crown, not a full covering over the head. Modest ivory high-neck blouse. Chest-up full head portrait, absolutely straight front-facing head and shoulders, eyes toward camera, head centered x50%, top of scarf y16%, eye line y40%, chin y60%, shoulders y76%; ample clean room around both cheeks for HTML overlays. Portrait 3:4 composition, fixed 85mm lens at eye level. Seamless pale blush #F8ECEE background, soft large diffused daylight, consistent soft shadows, refined tactile editorial photography. Quiet natural expression. This is the identity anchor for subsequent head-rotation frames. No text, no graphics, no logo, no watermark, no instruments, no before-and-after, no airbrushed plastic skin. Output one single photograph.

No text or graphics.
